notes: «وَ مِنْهُ» (and from him) points back to the previous report's last teacher; no previous report is supplied, so it stays a back_reference
«محمد بن الحسن» and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men, each with its own «حدثني» (rule 7 counter-example)
«أخيه» is a bare relation; «أبيه سيف بن عميرة» is one link with the name alone (rule 7)
the Imam named after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
